pageProps.title: Tiong Bahru Bakery
pageProps.review: Tiong Bahru Bakery at Fort Canning, Singapore, is an oasis-like cafe where you can enjoy delicious bread and cold coffee, making it a perfect spot to take a break during your travels.
pageProps.content: ## Review I visited this cafe because I had some time left before heading to the airport. It was like an oasis, providing the much-needed cold coffee during a heatwave. Both the bread and coffee were delicious. ## Pictures
